prompts.title: Men's Casual Fashion Studio Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create a photorealistic, high-end cinematic fashion portrait of a man, framed from the chest up in a vertical composition. Preserve the reference subject’s facial identity, facial proportions, and natural facial features with maximum accuracy. 
He wears a black baseball cap with a subtle brown leather-like front patch and round black eyeglasses with thin frames.
His outfit consists of a black hoodie layered over a white crew-neck T-shirt, topped with a bold color-blocked outdoor jacket featuring vivid orange, golden yellow, teal blue, and dark accents. The jacket is slightly open, revealing the hoodie underneath. Black backpack straps are visible over both shoulders.
Pose & expression: His head is tilted slightly upward as he looks toward the camera through his glasses, with a calm, serious, confident, and slightly contemplative expression, relaxed lips, and natural-looking eyes.
Lighting: Dramatic cinematic studio lighting with a strong warm orange key/rim light from the right side, creating glowing highlights along the right side of his face, ear, jacket, and shoulder. Detailed skin texture and detailed fabric highlights, with balanced shadows and excellent tonal depth.
Background: A clean, smooth, seamless deep-cyan-blue studio background, creating a polished and sophisticated backdrop. No objects, props, or other background elements.
Composition: Tight chest-up portrait, centered framing, subject occupying most of the frame, slight low-angle perspective, sharp focus on the eyes and face, realistic depth of field, premium editorial photography aesthetic.
Camera & quality: Professional full-frame camera, 85mm portrait lens, f/2.0, ultra-detailed skin texture, realistic fabric texture, cinematic color grading, HDR, crisp focus, natural proportions, 8K photorealistic quality.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Geometric Vector Portrait of a Man
prompts.prompt:
Create a stylized low-poly digital illustration of a confident man, shown in a dramatic close-up portrait from the chest up. He has thick, natural dark hair, deep-set eyes. His head is held straight with no tilt, maintaining a calm, serious, and confident expression while looking directly at the viewer.
Use a faceted polygonal art style, with sharp geometric shapes and layered angular planes defining the face, hair, neck, and clothing. Keep the facial proportions natural and highly recognizable if using a reference image. Render the skin in detailed monochromatic shades ranging from pure white and light gray to medium gray and deep charcoal, with strong geometric highlights and defined shadows for a bold, sculptural appearance.
He is wearing a black crew-neck shirt underneath a dark charcoal/black blazer, with angular folds and simplified geometric detailing.
The background should be bold graphic red, featuring dramatic black, dark-gray, and white sharp diagonal brush-like shapes and streaks radiating behind the subject, creating an energetic comic-book/editorial aesthetic. Use high contrast, crisp edges, minimal gradients, and clean vector-like shapes.
Composition: centered symmetrical portrait, head and shoulders dominant, slightly low camera angle, tight framing, strong visual presence.
Style: premium low-poly portrait, geometric vector illustration, modern editorial poster, bold graphic design, high contrast, ultra-detailed facial facets, sharp clean edges, dramatic lighting, 16K quality, no text, no watermark.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: High-Seas Luxury Portrait
prompts.prompt:

He is positioned slightly right of center, leaning casually against the polished wooden handrail with his left hand resting on the railing and his right hand tucked into his trouser pocket. His legs are crossed naturally at the ankles, creating a relaxed, confident pose. He has neatly styled hair, and wears elegant dark aviator sunglasses. His expression is calm, confident, and slightly contemplative, looking toward the left side of the frame.
He is dressed in a luxurious deep emerald-green double-breasted blazer with subtle gold buttons, a crisp white open-collar dress shirt, a neatly folded white pocket square, tailored white trousers, and polished dark brown leather loafers. The outfit has a refined old-money, Mediterranean luxury fashion aesthetic.
The scene is captured on the teak deck of a premium yacht, featuring polished wooden handrails, stainless-steel cable railings, and elegant yacht details. Behind him is a blue sky, vibrant turquoise-blue sea with several luxury yachts and sailboats anchored in the marina, distant green hills and coastal landscapes softly visible in the background. The water has natural ripples and beautiful reflections.
Warm golden-hour sunlight illuminates the subject from the right side, creating soft highlights on his face, hair, green blazer, and polished wooden yacht details, with gentle natural shadows for depth. The atmosphere is luxurious, calm, cinematic, and aspirational.
Composition: full-body vertical portrait, subject prominently framed, slightly low-to-eye-level perspective, natural leading lines from the yacht railing and deck guiding the eye toward the subject, balanced background with open sea and yachts.
Photography: ultra-realistic luxury fashion editorial photography, shot on a professional full-frame camera with an 85mm lens, f/1.8 aperture, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the subject, creamy blurred background, cinematic color grading, ultra-detailed skin texture, realistic fabric details, high dynamic range, soft atmospheric depth, photorealistic, 8K resolution, vertical composition.

prompts.title: Graphic Soul
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, ultra-detailed black-and-white studio portrait of a stylish person, captured in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference.
Subject & Outfit:
The subject is seated on a minimal metal folding chair, wearing an oversized tailored black blazer layered over a clean black shirt, paired with relaxed black trousers and chunky white-colored sneakers. Accessories include sleek dark sunglasses and a subtle minimal chain necklace. The outfit must appear crisp, structured, and completely wrinkle-free with clearly visible fabric texture and sharp detailing.
Pose & Expression:
Relaxed yet confident seated pose. One arm (right arm) is resting comfortably over the backrest of the chair, with the hand hanging naturally, while the other arm rests loosely on his thigh.
Legs are spread naturally, not overly wide, maintaining a balanced and grounded stance. Adding depth and a subtle dynamic to the pose. Calm, self-assured expression with a composed gaze directed toward the camera.
Composition & Framing (STRICT):
Full-body composition, subject centered with balanced negative space. A polished editorial look. No cropping of head or feet.
Lighting:
Soft professional studio lighting with gentle directional shadows falling subtly toward the right side of the floor. Even exposure across face and outfit — no harsh shadows or underexposure. Clean tonal contrast in monochrome.
Background:
Seamless pure white studio background with a soft gradient falloff, maintaining a clean minimalist aesthetic.
Graphic Elements (Doodles):
Surrounding the subject are bold, hand-drawn graffiti-style doodles in black, white, and vibrant orange accents. Elements include lightning bolts, arrows, stars, swirls, and abstract strokes. Integrated motivational text in a hand-drawn style:
“PURPOSE, CREATE YOUR PATH,”
“FAITH”
“FOCUS”
Doodles must be arranged in a visually balanced, symmetrical composition around the subject and must not cover or fill the entire background.
The doodles should feel energetic and dynamic while framing the subject without overlapping the face. Bright orange accents should pop against the monochrome scene.
Style & Quality:
Ultra-sharp focus, cinematic contrast, editorial fashion aesthetic, 8K resolution, high detail retention, clean monochrome subject with vibrant graphic highlights.

If any color appears outside the doodles, the result is incorrect.

prompts.title: The Gold Standard
prompts.prompt:
SUBJECT
[Reference Image Identity Preservation: High Priority] Full-body cinematic portrait of the man from the reference image. Pose: Casual lean against vehicle; right forearm resting on SUV hood, left hand partially submerged in jean pocket. Weight centered on right leg, left leg crossed at the ankle with toe-ground contact. Expression: Stoic, calm confidence, looking slightly off-axis. Attire: Layered tan suede shearling jacket with high-pile off-white fleece trim over a heavy-gauge ribbed white turtleneck. Black distressed slim-fit denim with articulated knee blowouts. Wheat-colored nubuck high-top lug-sole boots. Accessories: 14k gold curb-link chain, matte black tactical chronograph (left wrist), subtle wooden bead bracelet (right wrist), gold-rimmed geometric aviators.

VEHICLE & ENVIRONMENT
Vehicle: Matte-black modified luxury 4x4 (G-Wagon silhouette). Features: illuminated circular LED halo DRLs, heavy-duty winch-integrated bumper, low-profile roof rack with integrated LED light bar, 20-inch multi-spoke satin black wheels on aggressive A/T tires. Environment: Modernist luxury plaza with dark-grey basalt stone paving. Background: Colossal futuristic toroid-shaped (ring) skyscraper with central void, wrapped in horizontal golden electroluminescent bands. Dramatic deep-blue metropolitan skyline.

COMPOSITION & LIGHTING
Framing: Eye-level 4:5 vertical fashion editorial. Lighting: Chiaroscuro-inspired urban night scheme. Soft-box diffused key light (3200K) at 45-degree camera-left for facial modeling. High-intensity golden architectural backlighting creating a sharp rim-glow on the shearling texture and subject silhouette. Reflections: Specular highlights on stone ground and matte vehicle surfaces. Teal-and-orange color science with deep blacks and vibrant golden accents.

TECHNICAL SPECS
Optics: Shot on 85mm f/1.4 prime lens. Texture: Macro-level epidermal resolution; visible skin pores, individual eyebrow follicles, and realistic beard stubble. No skin smoothing. Depth: Shallow depth-of-field with creamy architectural bokeh. Rendering: Subsurface scattering on skin, high-fidelity textile weaving, 8K resolution, ray-traced reflections, chromatic consistency, photorealistic fashion editorial aesthetic.

NEGATIVE PROMPT
Low-resolution, airbrushed skin, plastic texture, face-swap artifacts, distorted anatomy, cross-eyed, blurry facial features, flat lighting, overexposed highlights, CGI aesthetic, poorly rendered hands, messy fur texture, floating accessories, inconsistent lighting shadows.

prompts.prompt:

THE SCENE:** A perfectly centered, front-facing iPhone 16 Pro stands on a smooth, vibrant orange radial gradient studio background with a subtle grounding drop shadow.
THE BREAKOUT ACTION: Based strictly on the reference image's identity, a confident man wearing blue aviator sunglasses, a gray hoodie, and blue jeans is physically emerging from the screen. His head, right shoulder, and a strongly foreshortened right hand extend powerfully toward the viewer, breaking the phone's frame. His body remains inside the screen against a heavily blurred cinematic night city bokeh.
CRITICAL UI LAYERING: Inside the screen, a realistic green iOS message notification banner reading "Hello – Prompt Plum" is positioned across his torso. Crucially, this banner appears behind his emerging right hand but in front of his chest.
LIGHTING: High-end professional studio lighting from the front-left, creating realistic highlights and shadows on the emerging subject and the phone."
